### Likely transformation

The main substrate is the ethyl ester:

`CCOC(=O)COCc1noc([C@H](CCCC2CCCCC2)CC(=O)NO)n1`

The other components correspond to **LiOH**, **water**, and **1,4-dioxane**. The reaction is a **lithium hydroxide-mediated ester saponification** in aqueous 1,4-dioxane.

Specifically:

\[
\mathrm{-CH_2CO_2Et \longrightarrow -CH_2CO_2H}
\]

The oxadiazole ring, hydroxamic-acid group, ether linkage, stereocenter, and cyclohexylbutyl substituent remain unchanged.

### Major product

**Product SMILES:**

`C1(CCCCC1)CCC[C@H](CC(=O)NO)C1=NC(=NO1)COCC(=O)O`

This is the corresponding **carboxylic acid**, retaining the hydroxamic-acid substituent and chiral oxadiazole-containing framework.

### Conditions

- **Base:** LiOH  
- **Solvents:** water and 1,4-dioxane  
- **Reported time:** approximately 2 h  
- **Reported yield:** approximately 95.4%  

The product is shown in its neutral acid form, implying aqueous workup/acidification after hydrolysis.

### Transformation

\text{–CO}_2\text{Et} \;\longrightarrow\; \text{–CO}_2\text{H}
\]

```text
O=C(O)COCc1noc([C@H](CCCC2CCCCC2)CC(=O)NO)n1
```

```text
C1(CCCCC1)CCC[C@H](CC(=O)NO)C1=NC(=NO1)COCC(=O)O
```

The immediate product under basic conditions may be the corresponding **lithium carboxylate**; the neutral carboxylic acid shown above is expected after aqueous acidification/workup.
